title: INDICLLMSUITE: A BLUEPRINT FOR CREATING PRE-TRAINING AND FINE-TUNING DATASETS FOR INDIAN LANGUAGES
reasoning: The paper features a major component dedicated to safety alignment ('INDICALIGN - TOXIC' and 'TOXIC MATRIX' sections) which uses a taxonomy of unethical and harmful content (including fraudulent activities, suicidal ideation, and malicious intent) to evaluate and train model refusal behaviors. This alignment work is grounded in ethical safety and moral considerations for LLM behavior.
